paper.title_en: Leading four-Goldstone inelasticity in custodial partial waves
paper.abstract_en: Exactly elastic partial-wave constructions omit multiparticle flux. We compute the complete leading four-Goldstone cut generated by the O(p<sup loc="post">2</sup>) 2 → 4 amplitude in the massless, parity-even O(4)/O(3) Goldstone effective field theory (EFT); it enters elastic partial-wave unitarity at O(p<sup loc="post">8</sup>). For the custodial-vector wave the result is the consistency condition <math altimg="si3.svg"><mrow><mo>−</mo><mi>Im</mi><mrow><mo>(</mo><mn>1</mn><mo linebreak="badbreak">/</mo><msub><mi>t</mi><mn>11</mn></msub><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo linebreak="goodbreak">=</mo><mn>1</mn><mo linebreak="goodbreak">+</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mn>5.0349</mn><mo>±</mo><mn>0.0003</mn><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo linebreak="goodbreak">×</mo><msup><mn>10</mn><mrow><mo>−</mo><mn>7</mn></mrow></msup><msup><mrow><mo>(</mo><mi>E</mi><mo>/</mo><mi>v</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mn>4</mn></msup><mo linebreak="goodbreak">+</mo><mi>O</mi><mrow><mo>(</mo><msup><mi>p</mi><mn>6</mn></msup><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math>, where E is the center-of-mass energy, v the Goldstone decay constant, and the quoted uncertainty is numerical only. Any inelastic completion matching this massless pure-Goldstone EFT through O(p<sup loc="post">8</sup>) must reproduce this condition. Writing I and J for custodial isospin and angular momentum, four-body unitarity also gives the exact leading-order positive partial-wave sum rule <math altimg="si4.svg"><mrow><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>I</mi></msub><mo linebreak="goodbreak">=</mo><mn>32</mn><mi>π</mi><msub><mo>∑</mo><mi>J</mi></msub><mrow><mo>(</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>J</mi><mo linebreak="badbreak">+</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>)</mo></mrow><msub><mi>C</mi><mrow><mi>I</mi><mi>J</mi></mrow></msub></mrow></math>, with CIJ ≥ 0 and <math altimg="si5.svg"><mrow><mi>I</mi><mo linebreak="goodbreak">+</mo><mi>J</mi></mrow></math> even; in the isovector channel, <math altimg="si6.svg"><mrow><mi>J</mi><mo linebreak="goodbreak">=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></math> carries 88.17% of the production rate and J ≤ 3 carries 96.88%. Each AI is quoted for one normalized component of its custodial multiplet. Independent factorized-Sobol quasi-Monte Carlo and RAMBO phase-space Monte Carlo calculations agree for the custodial coefficients, the resolved odd-spin spectrum through <math altimg="si2.svg"><mrow><mi>J</mi><mo linebreak="goodbreak">=</mo><mn>15</mn></mrow></math>, and all ten representative charge-channel rates. Finite-mass electroweak observables and O(p<sup loc="post">10</sup>) production corrections lie beyond this calculation.
